lark_e08_entry.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_entry.text: The gathering on Day Sixty Two began with a man discovering that his awning's written stall number had washed away. Two vendors claimed the dry space beneath it. The market keeper found the booking source and directed each to the place actually reserved. Nobody had to decide ownership from the confidence of a wet piece of cloth. Lin passed with her midday bowl, glad that the first dispute belonged to someone else's received job. She would hear Shan Fang's childcare proposal after the family finished its actual morning deliveries.

lark_e08_entry_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_entry_002.text: Qin Yi had arranged her paper animals beside the shrine room's window. She asked Lin whether the goat's beard made it look wiser or merely older. Lin chose wiser, which the child said was correct. Shan Fang required the scenery to remain clear of the mending baskets and helped make a shallow tray for carrying it to the performance. The child had prepared under the room arrangement she actually received earlier in the week. Now the result would be seen by children whose applause depended on amusement rather than gratitude.

lark_e08_entry_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_entry_003.text: Lin sat at the table while Qin Yi showed the performance's current beginning. She remembered how the rehearsal's room and weather had changed its preparation. The child remembered too, although she expressed the matter through what the examiner was permitted to wear. Lin let the paper figures have their own argument. A mountain's important choices did not all concern tests and signal fittings. Some determined whether a child's scene reached its beginning with the ending still attached, and whether she wanted a particular adult to see it.

lark_e08_rehearsal_gate.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_rehearsal_gate.text: Qin Yi set the examiner beside the goat. The scene retained the actual result of her earlier rehearsal, including the scenery it had kept or lost. Lin would see that preparation as it now stood, rather than imagine both afternoons had enjoyed the same protected room.

lark_e08_windy_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_windy_001.text: The replacement shoe was a plain little square. Qin Yi had cut it from Lin's offered private scrap after the original escaped onto a closed roof. She said the examiner had lost his handsome shoe during a storm and should therefore walk in an ugly one. The altered scene worked, but its ending had been rehearsed only once with all the children present. Shan Fang would stand near the performance entrance to remind the youngest child when to bring the goat forward. Lin's longer quiet practice had been real, and so had this narrower preparation.

lark_e08_windy_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_windy_002.text: Qin Yi did not want Lin to tell the audience where the original shoe had gone. The examiner's fictional storm belonged to the scene, and her real disappointment belonged to her. Lin agreed. She asked whether the child still minded that she had kept the bright table. Qin Yi said yes, then admitted that the offered scrap had been useful. It was possible to dislike a decision and accept help afterward. Shan Fang left them enough quiet for the admission without trying to turn it into a lesson spoken by an adult.

lark_e08_windy_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_windy_003.text: The child handed Lin the scenery tray and asked her to inspect its loose corner. That trust had not restored the missed rehearsal. It gave them something present to do together. Lin held the tray low while Qin Yi fixed the fold from beneath. The goat stood without falling, and the ugly shoe remained securely tied to its examiner. Shan Fang received the prepared tray and took it back to the shelf. The performance would go ahead with its changed scene and a real adult cue at the entrance.

lark_e08_sheltered_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_sheltered_001.text: The oversized shoe filled nearly a third of the little examiner. Qin Yi had practised using it twice in the sheltered room, and the other children knew when to make the goat point out its absurd length. The protected rehearsal had let them keep the ending intact. Lin's own independent comparison had stopped after the lower desk's shorter hour, and that missing task order had required work at the next formal meeting. Neither part of the bargain needed to be hidden for this morning to feel pleasant.

lark_e08_sheltered_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_sheltered_002.text: Qin Yi wanted Lin in the audience so she could see whether the shoe joke still made an adult laugh. Lin said she would answer after hearing the evening's practical plan. The child accepted the delay more easily than she had accepted the earlier uncertainty about a room. She had a scene ready now, and readiness left space for other people to have appointments. Shan Fang heard this and touched her daughter's hair without promising the guest's attendance. The child's good mood could not be used as a signature on somebody else's evening.

lark_e08_sheltered_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_sheltered_003.text: Lin held the scenery tray while Qin Yi tested the repaired goat's neck. The paper figure bowed deeply and rose without folding in the wrong place. The child gave the oversized shoe a last proud glance before Shan Fang took the tray to the shelf. The protected room had produced more than a pleased feeling: the children had a repeated ending, intact scenery, and less need for an adult to prompt the sequence. Lin could see the specific benefit her shorter practice hour had purchased.

lark_e08_offer_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_001.text: Qin had been offered one freight delivery at the performance hour. It would pay six copper after receiving if he accepted and completed it. Shan Fang's repaired glove stall had a separate accepted reservation with a two copper refundable deposit. She could use it, cancel before noon and recover the deposit, or lose the deposit by failing to appear. Neither offer meant money had already been earned. Their child needed an actual adult responsible for the two hours around her performance, with a receiving place and both parents' ordinary contacts.

lark_e08_offer_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_002.text: They could divide the evening themselves by declining Qin's freight offer. Shan Fang would staff the stall while he watched the child. They could also ask Lin to take the one child's seated watch, if her current recovery plan permitted it and she actually agreed. There was a paid alternative: Wei Chun, the widow whose basket liners had been received in the rain, offered a two hour watch for three copper. The local keeper had checked her ordinary references for that service. She was available only if booked before noon, and her work would be paid after receiving.

lark_e08_offer_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_003.text: Lin visited Wei Chun's offered watch place with both parents. It was the sheltered lower room, within the performance's actual entrance and return route. Its keeper had accepted the use. Wei Chun would have one child under this booking, no invisible crowd of children supposedly protected by the same fee. She named the parents' contact places and the ordinary procedure if Qin Yi became ill or wanted to leave. Qin Yi asked whether she could still carry the goat. Wei Chun said the goat could attend as long as it did not block the doorway.

lark_e08_offer_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_004.text: The child's unpowered paper animal made the room seem more ordinary than its careful agreement. Wei Chun said she had learned the contact question after a parent once promised to be nearby and went down a closed freight stair. That former parent was not named. The story explained why a hopeful description of vicinity would not answer today's question. Qin's proposed freight receiving and Shan Fang's stall were both reachable by the current open route. Lin could visit the demonstration elsewhere and return at the watch's received end if she chose to fund it.

lark_e08_offer_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_005.text: A qualified carpenter was giving a public seated demonstration of fixture ratings at the same hour. Lin had not accepted an appointment there, but a place remained available. The distinction between a supported shelf and a load hung from its edge interested her after the mending room's argument. She could hear the demonstration if Wei Chun was booked. She could miss it while taking the child watch. She could also choose a quiet evening at lodging, leaving the parents to arrange their own finite jobs. Nobody called the missed talk an emergency.

lark_e08_offer_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_006.text: Shan Fang asked Lin directly, with Qin Yi outside the conversation. Two hours of seated child watch would remain within Lin's current ordinary rest plan if she did not take lifting or running tasks. Either parent would receive a call for those needs. Lin could accept that limited favor, decline it, or offer to pay the actual three copper watch without accepting the attendant's task herself. The parents would not borrow her answer from the affection she had already shown their child. Noon would close both Wei Chun's booking and the stall's refundable cancellation.

lark_e08_offer_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_007.text: Qin looked uncomfortable asking a recovering guest for help. Lin said asking plainly was easier than discovering a duty through a child's happy assumption. He took the correction without making another request. Shan Fang could manage the stall alone if the childcare were properly arranged; she could not simultaneously leave it to see the performance. The family's choices had room for one sacrifice of time or a real purchase of care. Lin considered her own rest, curiosity, wage purse, and wish to help before she answered.

lark_e08_offer_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_offer_008.text: She had forty eight copper in received wages before her personal purchases, and had kept ordinary road money separate. Paying three for care would be affordable and would reduce what she could later spend on herself. Accepting the watch would cost the fixture demonstration and the freedom of that evening. Declining would keep her quiet recovery time and leave Qin's six copper offer unaccepted. The household could survive all three outcomes. Surviving an outcome did not make its opportunity, labor, or money cost unreal.

lark_e08_evening_choice.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_choice.text: Noon was near enough that an answer would soon become a booking or a refusal. Lin could give her two hours, give three earned copper for a qualified attendant, or keep her recovery evening while the parents changed their own jobs. She named the arrangement she was actually willing to perform and let the others answer from that concrete offer.

choices.text: Accept the limited seated watch and miss the fixture demonstration.
Pay three copper for Wei Chun's received watch and attend the seated demonstration.
Keep the quiet recovery evening; the parents will staff their own childcare.

lark_e08_evening_watch.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_watch.text: Lin accepted the seated watch for the one child. Both parents repeated its low activity limits and named their actual receiving places. Qin accepted the freight job before its offer closed. Wei Chun received a timely refusal, leaving her free to accept another offered task rather than wait for Lin's undecided generosity. Shan Fang kept the glove stall. Lin released the demonstration seat to another interested reader. Three people now had accepted work at separate places, and her evening had become a responsibility instead of an available space in somebody else's plan.

lark_e08_evening_watch_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_watch_002.text: At the watch's beginning, Qin Yi arrived with her prepared tray and an ordinary snack from home. Shan Fang received Lin's presence and the agreed contact details before leaving for the stall just outside the performance entrance. The other children came with their own responsible adults. Lin was not made their attendant because she knew the scene. She sat where Qin Yi could set the tray down without climbing over her shoulder. When a younger child asked her to lift him onto the stage, she directed the request to his actual guardian.

lark_e08_evening_watch_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_watch_003.text: The paper goat reached the audience with its scenery as prepared. Shan Fang closed her stall's sales for the scene's first few minutes and stood at the entrance for the cue she had actually promised where needed. Customers saw the short pause posted rather than finding an abandoned table. Lin watched Qin Yi perform beside the child's named return place. The audience laughed at the examiner's shoe. One child laughed too early, which made the actors pause and discover that a joke could be useful even when it arrived ahead of its instruction.

lark_e08_evening_watch_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_watch_004.text: After the scene, Qin Yi wanted to run to every stall in the market. Lin reminded her of the seated watch agreement and offered the two nearby places within its accepted route. The child chose the toy sled seller. His sample had its projecting peg removed, and he let her inspect the bottom before asking whether she wanted to buy. Qin Yi had no purchase money and declined with the gravity of an expert. Lin watched from the low bench while the seller answered her ordinary questions. Their limited walk ended at the receiving room.

lark_e08_evening_watch_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_watch_005.text: A noise from the demonstration carried across the stair. Lin could hear the carpenter's voice but not its explanation of the fixture model. She did not turn two indistinct phrases into a lesson she had somehow attended. Her chosen evening had lost that opportunity. Qin Yi wanted to know why she was looking toward the sound. Lin said the demonstration had interested her and she had chosen this watch instead. The child was quiet for a moment, then asked whether a goat could have watched her while Lin went there.

lark_e08_evening_watch_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_watch_006.text: Qin received his actual delivery at the freight window and was paid six copper under its separate accepted offer. Shan Fang received payment for completed glove work at her stall, with its rent charged under the agreed booking. Neither income came from Lin's appropriation. They arrived together at the watch's end and received their daughter back in the agreed room. Lin reported the performance, the short toy stall visit, and the ordinary snack. No fee was owed for the favor she had accepted. She was tired in the exact way two hours with a child could make a person tired.

lark_e08_evening_watch_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_watch_007.text: The family invited her to a late bowl of soup. Lin declined because her own accepted recovery plan still needed a quiet final hour. Shan Fang sent the bowl with her instead of making attendance the price of thanks. Qin Yi carried it only to the lodging stair before her father took the pot home. Lin ate seated in her room, with the fixture demonstration still unheard. The favor had helped two people earn their real evening work. Its cost to her time had not vanished because their thanks were sincere.

lark_e08_evening_sponsor.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_sponsor.text: Lin offered to pay Wei Chun's actual three copper watch after receiving. The attendant accepted the booking, both parents accepted the contacts and scope, and Lin kept the payment in her own purse until the work was done. Qin accepted his separate six copper freight offer. Shan Fang kept her glove stall. Lin accepted the seated demonstration place while it was still available. No child had been watched and no job completed yet. The arrangements now named people who would actually attend instead of relying on one household's general good fortune.

lark_e08_evening_sponsor_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_sponsor_002.text: At the beginning of the watch, Lin went with Qin Yi and both parents to the lower room. Wei Chun received the child, the prepared scenery tray, and the two ordinary contact places. Her service was for this one child under this booking. The other performers had their own adults. Lin left for the demonstration after watching the handoff actually occur. She had purchased a defined task from a qualified person, not escaped responsibility by leaving money on an absent chair. Qin Yi waved the goat toward her as she took the open stair.

lark_e08_evening_sponsor_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_sponsor_003.text: The carpenter's model stood on a low table with every load supported in an ordinary box. He explained the fixture rating for a shelf's supported surface, then hung a small model weight from its front edge. The change increased the force on a joint without changing the object's written weight. Lin could see why a shelf number did not authorize every way of loading it. A household reader asked whether two smaller weights would solve the problem. The carpenter moved them along the edge and showed that position mattered beside their sum.

lark_e08_evening_sponsor_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_sponsor_004.text: He permitted the public drawing to be copied and named the physical joint his example used. Lin wrote its actual condition rather than extracting a universal formula for every wall. The mending room's shelf was installed differently and would need its own carpenter's judgment before being altered. She could still use the demonstration to ask a better question. That was the opportunity the paid watch had made available. Three copper bought two hours of care; the care let her sit here. It did not buy a new cultivation pair through a side door.

lark_e08_evening_sponsor_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_sponsor_005.text: When Lin arrived afterward, Wei Chun reported the performance watch she had actually completed so far. She had brought Qin Yi to the accepted entrance and remained at the named return place. Shan Fang had briefly paused stall sales for her promised cue, then resumed the posted work. Qin Yi told Lin that the audience had laughed before the proper place. Lin had missed that live joke even though she knew the prepared story. The child repeated its ending for her. Buying care had let Lin attend the talk, not occupy two audiences simultaneously.

lark_e08_evening_sponsor_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_sponsor_006.text: At the two hour end, Qin and Shan Fang received their child in the lower room. Qin's completed freight work had earned its six copper. Shan Fang had received the stall's actual repair payments under the separately paid rent. Lin heard Wei Chun's ordinary watch report and paid three from her own earned purse after the service was received. The attendant accepted the payment and closed the booking. The family's work had happened because a defined piece of care had been funded, and the person doing that care had been paid rather than praised in place of money.

lark_e08_evening_sponsor_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_sponsor_007.text: Lin went back to lodging with the public fixture drawing and a smaller wage purse. She told the keeper only what the model had actually shown. He brought out a shelf bracket he had been considering and said he would ask its carpenter about the altered load position before fitting it. Lin had no authority to rate it herself. Later, she drank the soup Shan Fang sent as a gift, not a refund of the attendant's pay. The evening had given her a useful question and missed Qin Yi's live performance. Both results belonged to the choice.

lark_e08_evening_quiet.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_quiet.text: Lin declined the watch and the sponsorship, keeping the quiet evening in her current recovery plan. Qin did not accept the freight offer. He would watch his daughter while Shan Fang staffed the glove stall. Wei Chun received the timely refusal before noon and could offer her time elsewhere. The demonstration seat remained for another interested reader. Lin's refusal did not leave the child without an adult or force the household into an unstaffed stall. It cost Qin the six copper delivery opportunity that he actually set aside.

lark_e08_evening_quiet_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_quiet_002.text: Shan Fang said she understood and meant it. Qin looked disappointed, which Lin let be true without taking the expression as proof that her answer had been unkind. He had asked because the offer interested him. It no longer fit the household's available people. The child asked whether Lin disliked the goat scene. Shan Fang explained the difference before Lin could offer another promise to repair the moment. A recovering person's quiet hour could belong to her even when somebody else had prepared an excellent paper animal.

lark_e08_evening_quiet_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_quiet_003.text: Qin received his daughter's evening watch from Shan Fang at the lower room. Lin saw the ordinary handoff on her way to lodging. Qin Yi's tray stood beside her father's stool, ready for the scene. Shan Fang's stall lay near the entrance, where she could post a short sales pause for the promised cue. The other children's care would remain with their own adults. Lin knew those arrangements from the accepted plan. She left before the performance began, with no cart job secretly completed by the father now seated beside his daughter.

lark_e08_evening_quiet_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_quiet_004.text: Lin ate alone at the lodging's common table before going upstairs. The keeper had left her meal within the actual received lodging provision. She used the clinician's cloth roll and the current ordinary movement plan, then stopped before the fatigue she had been trying to prevent. The window was open far enough for the market's laughter to reach her without its words. She could not infer how the paper scene had gone from that sound. She allowed herself to be curious without leaving the accepted rest merely to settle the curiosity.

lark_e08_evening_quiet_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_quiet_005.text: Next morning, Qin told Lin about the watch he had completed. His daughter had enjoyed the audience's early laugh and wanted to repeat it deliberately. Shan Fang had received the glove repair payments and paid the stall's agreed rent. Qin had earned no freight fee; another carrier had accepted the offered delivery. He had seen his daughter's whole scene. The lost six copper still mattered to the household, and the performance mattered to him. Neither needed to be declared the only true result. Lin listened while he wrapped the scenery for storage.

lark_e08_evening_quiet_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_quiet_006.text: Qin Yi performed the ending for Lin after breakfast on the lower landing. Lin listened seated and laughed at the place the child had decided was funniest. The child asked whether her quiet room had been more entertaining. Lin said it had been quieter, which was what she had needed. Qin Yi accepted the answer after deciding quietness was something adults collected the way children collected smooth stones. She gave Lin the smallest paper shoe as an ordinary gift. It was not an invoice for a watch she had declined.

lark_e08_evening_quiet_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_evening_quiet_007.text: Lin kept her three copper and missed both the live performance and the fixture demonstration. Her shoulder was no longer tired from an added evening's activity, but that rest was not a miraculous cure or a new stage. She wrote the next practice question while the room was still quiet. At the family's table later, Qin spoke of another freight offer he would ask about on its actual date. The missed booking had not destroyed their relationship. It had taught them the ordinary difficulty of fitting affection, work, and recovery into the same two hours.

lark_e08_after_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_001.text: By Day Sixty Three, the evening's actual arrangement had ended. The received watch or parental watch required no continuing invitation from Lin, and the missed jobs or paid fees stayed in their proper accounts. She could greet Qin Yi without owing another two hours because she had once helped, or because she had once declined. Shan Fang made the next household meal invitation as an ordinary new question. Lin accepted the meal after her scheduled shift. Their relationship had survived a choice whose costs nobody needed to erase.

lark_e08_after_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_002.text: The thirteenth accepted work shift was received that afternoon, adding four copper and bringing Lin's paid wages to fifty two. The ordinary clinician's second assessment had been kept on Day Fifty Four before the board session, at the agreed five copper cost; thirty copper remained in that assessment portion. Its current low movement plan still applied. The work keeper read it beside the day's task rather than interpreting fifth pair practice as a new ordinary lifting permission. Lin's shoulder could be improving under one movement and unreliable under another without either result becoming deceit.

lark_e08_after_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_003.text: A travelling singer arrived with a drum whose skin had stretched in the wet weather. He asked the market keeper for a performance space and the carpenter for a dry place to restore the instrument. The offered spaces were different. The carpenter did not let the drum occupy the workshop's receiving bench during actual repairs. He cleared a corner after those repairs were done. The singer waited without announcing that an artist's delay was more important than a carpenter's work. Lin watched him tap the loose skin and search for its proper note.

lark_e08_after_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_004.text: He invited her to tell him a mountain story while it dried. She had several, most of which belonged to other people's private work. She offered the public account of the shrine room becoming useful after the stored boxes were sorted under actual permission. The singer preferred a ghost in the boxes. Lin could not supply one. He invented a ghost for his own song and told her plainly that it was his invention. That distinction made it easier to enjoy the song when he performed it later beside the lower stair.

lark_e08_after_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_005.text: The ghost hated needles and loved wet caps. It therefore haunted exactly the room it least wanted to inhabit. Children found this a convincing reason for a ghost to be bad tempered. Qin Yi accused it of being less foolish than the examiner who bought the wrong shoe. The singer let her argue and added a shoe to the second verse. He did not tell the market that Duan had actually met a ghost. Lin heard how readily ordinary truth could join an invented story without either being mistaken for the other's evidence, if the performer named the change.

lark_e08_after_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_006.text: That afternoon, the shrine room's keeper counted the stools. The carpenter could make two more before winter, but not under the completed shelf price. The neighbors had enough in their own contribution jar for one. They disagreed about whether to buy one now or wait until they could afford both. Lin offered no coin automatically. The carpenter named the actual price and a date through which he could hold it. The keeper put the offer beside the contribution jar. The room had achieved the useful state of producing problems specific enough to be priced.

lark_e08_after_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_007.text: Shan Fang wanted the first extra stool now, because somebody had been standing through every crowded gathering. Another woman preferred a matching pair later. Qin suggested that nobody had yet proved matching stools made stitches straighter. The woman said they might make a room look less like a storage yard. Lin found both positions intelligible and had no vote in the neighbors' contribution. She sat on the window ledge while they chose one useful stool now and left the second as a later request. The carpenter received the actual order, not a wish to deliver both.

lark_e08_after_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_008.text: Shan Fang's sister reached the pass on Day Sixty Four with a small bundle and her return fare untouched. She had accepted the four day family visit, without expecting wages at a nonexistent stall job. The sisters embraced at the landing and then argued over who had brought the heavier bag. Qin had prepared the one spare pallet. Qin Yi wanted the visitor to stay until the next gathering. Shan Fang explained the four actual days before the child could recruit the whole household into a campaign against the return coach.

lark_e08_after_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_009.text: The visitor's name was Shan Lu. She brought dried plums as an ordinary family gift, not as payment for the pallet. She wanted to hear how the shrine room had become a place women could mend together instead of visiting one kitchen at a time. Shan Fang took her there after supper. Lin accompanied them only when invited. The room was crowded enough for the newly ordered stool to feel immediately sensible. Shan Lu watched one woman repair a sleeve and said she had travelled farther for conversations that had given her less useful instruction.

lark_e08_after_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_010.text: Lin asked Shan Lu whether she preferred to learn by watching a whole task first or by trying its first movement. Shan Lu wanted to try, which surprised Lin after so much careful observer work. The sleeve's owner agreed, and the woman teaching placed an ordinary scrap beside the real garment. Shan Lu made three stitches in the scrap and undid one after discovering the thread crossed itself. She laughed at the knot instead of blaming the teacher. Lin realized that practice could be properly offered without every learner sharing her own anxiety about what an error revealed.

lark_e08_after_011.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_011.text: Qin Yi tried to give the visitor the turnip hound's head for the road. Shan Lu said it would be crushed in the coach unless she carried nothing else. The child offered to carry everything else for her, then remembered the visit's ending was several days away. They agreed on a smaller drawing whose paper could lie flat inside the bundle. Lin watched Qin Yi select a particular memory to make portable rather than insisting the whole animal must be preserved. The giant shoe would stay on the mountain, where its joke had an audience.

lark_e08_after_012.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_012.text: On Day Sixty Five, Duan's fifth formal meeting returned to the fifth pair's incomplete second movement. His knee allowed the low seated demonstration but not the standing comparison he had considered. He changed the lesson accordingly before receiving Lin's consent to the revised task. She had recovered from the earlier short attempts and the gathering under her actual chosen evening plan. The board's current check remained independent. The new task used the same small registered ceiling, with a clear stop after its first useful movement. There was no bargain to compensate for a modified lesson by adding input.

lark_e08_after_013.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_013.text: Lin began from the fixed primary trunk reference into the proposed third upper limb primary pair. It was one of the remaining ordinary primary pairs, not a governing or conception bridge. Her arm stayed low and supported, with no new overhead permission from its name. The first movement carried its measured small useful task, then discharged into the grounded release. She rested before the second. The next attempt reached its intended reference but still failed to complete the useful movement. Its failure no longer made the earlier completed interruption imaginary.

lark_e08_after_014.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_014.text: Duan asked her to show why the second attempt had been stopped. She pointed to the board's received task criterion and the incomplete useful result. Jiang's current external record agreed. The explanation depended on what had happened, not on Lin deciding she felt too discouraged to continue. She could now stop without waiting for disappointment to make the decision easy. Duan received that improvement beside the still incomplete route. The fifth formal meeting earned its four copper fee, leaving fifteen meetings and sixty copper in the accepted teaching scope.

lark_e08_after_015.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_015.text: Lin put the new record below the earlier attempt and ate before comparing them again. The first useful movement had repeated under one permitted condition. She did not write stable beside the whole pair. It would need repeated changed task work, recovery, and the later independent tests alongside the sixth pair. The distance to certification still looked long. It was also more specific than before. There was work to do at a named movement instead of a general demand to become stronger, and people whose actual scopes could help her do it.

lark_e08_after_016.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_016.text: Rao Ji found her at the lower wall after the practice. He had not observed the attempt and asked whether she wanted to tell him about it. She described the completed first movement and failed second one. He did not turn the account into a public score against another trainee. He offered his earlier standing invitation to observe a stopped small talisman task when his own current knee and reserve allowed it. The association keeper now had a possible date on Day Sixty Nine. Lin asked to receive the conditions before she accepted the observation.

lark_e08_after_017.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_017.text: Rao said the talisman maintained an inspection light at a fixed contact, not the whole freight bell. Its external backing and pigment had ratings of their own. A practitioner with six pairs could still ruin it by treating those ratings as a compliment to his personal reserve. Lin asked whether she might compare his stopped release with her own primary task release without copying the talisman's private pattern. He said that was the sort of question the keeper could authorize. The possible appointment became a limited technical observation, with no technique handed over during a conversation.

lark_e08_after_018.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_018.text: Chen Rui arrived while they were talking, bringing a new supplier letter to the association keeper. He would not open it on the wall merely because both people were interested. Rao went with him to the proper receiving room. Lin stayed outside with her lunch bowl. The choice not to follow felt less like exclusion than it would have a month earlier. She had an actual question for a future authorized session. She did not need every closed meeting to contain the missing part of her progress.

lark_e08_after_019.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_019.text: Her fourteenth shift was received on Day Sixty Six. The paid total rose to fifty six copper. The sixth weekly meal and lodging provision was received within its accepted dates, making thirty copper in that category. There was no new fifth pair attempt that day. Lin performed ordinary work, ate, and walked the current open lower loop. Shan Lu sat at the shrine window learning the sleeve repair she had begun. The four day visitor had found enough to do without being placed on anybody's employment roll.

lark_e08_after_020.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_020.text: On Day Sixty Seven, Lin completed the fifteenth accepted shift and received its four copper, bringing wages to sixty. She would not take another powered practice before the next received recovery check and lesson. The work keeper had heard that she was developing another route and asked whether that changed her accepted task. She said it did not. The keeper took the answer plainly. A good worker was not required to become a different worker every time a lesson improved. Her ordinary usefulness had already been received for ninety hours.

lark_e08_after_021.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_021.text: The sisters spent their last visiting evening in the mending room with Qin Yi's small road drawing between them. Shan Lu's return fare was still in her own purse, and the ordinary coach booking named tomorrow. Shan Fang wanted one more day and did not ask the sister to spend a fare she could not replace. They chose the bowl they would eat together before departure. Lin understood the ordinary strength of ending a happy visit while it remained affordable. The room did not become emptier because someone had wisely refused to turn four days into six.

lark_e08_after_022.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_022.text: Qin asked the visitor whether the spare pallet had been comfortable. Shan Lu said it had been just large enough to let her complain about turning over without getting out of bed. He received this as praise. Qin Yi said the next visitor should be a goat, which would stand up and save the pallet. Lin pointed out that a goat might have entirely different opinions about the stored sleeve baskets. The child drew one eating a glove. Nobody mistook the picture for a booking. The laugh made the sister's last evening less solemn.

lark_e08_after_023.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_after_023.text: Lin returned to lodging with the expected meeting on Day Sixty Nine still ahead. The sixth pair had not yet begun practice, and the fifth remained incomplete under its second movement. Her current stage stayed four pairs. The household choices of the gathering had produced real work, missed opportunities, fees, and time in different arrangements. They had not unlocked a hidden power. The mountain was becoming a place where she could recognize a question's proper receiver. Her next difficult question concerned what a supplier could ask a working student to promise.

lark_e08_crossing_notice.speaker: narrator
lark_e08_crossing_notice.text: Before the room closed, the shrine keeper brought a current gallery notice from the qualified freight crew. A timber check had found fresh movement at one receiving support after the rain. The crew had reduced the permitted load while it inspected the adjoining joints; it had not declared a collapse or blamed the new supplier sample. Qin read the changed rating beside tomorrow's booking and accepted a lighter load with its stated fee. Shan Fang copied the public closure hour for the mending visitors. Lin watched an ordinary warning alter actual plans before anybody had a dramatic story about it.
